title: CMAT 2026 Results Announced: Check Your Scorecard
summary: NTA declared the CMAT 2026 results yesterday. Cutoffs for top MBA colleges like JBIMS and SIMSREE are expected to rise by 2-3 percentile points this year.

title: CBSE Class 12 Board Exams Begin Today
summary: Over 16 lakh students appear for the CBSE Class 12 board exams starting today. Critical guidelines issued for exam centers regarding electronic devices.

title: NEET UG 2026 Registration Ends in 2 Days
summary: Last chance for medical aspirants! The registration window for NEET UG 2026 closes on Feb 20th. No further extensions will be provided.

title: JEE Main Session 2: City Intimation Slips Out
summary: NTA has released the advance city intimation slips for JEE Main 2026 Session 2. Download now to plan travel. Admit cards expected next week.

title: IIM CAP 2026 Interviews Scheduling Open
summary: The Common Admission Process (CAP) for the 9 new IIMs has started interview scheduling. Shortlisted candidates must book slots before Feb 25.

title: BITSAT 2026 Exam Dates Revised
summary: BITS Pilani has slightly adjusted the Session 1 dates to avoid clash with state board exams. Check the updated brochure.
